intent.description: Fetch the seat map and upgrade pricing for an existing Southwest reservation, returning each seat's row, column, type (Front Cabin / Extra Legroom / Standard / Exit Row), price, and availability for upgrade selection.
intent.userSaid: i logged in and navigated to the my trips section i clicked view details on one of the reservations i clicked upgrade seats and now it's showing me the seat map and showing me the options

parameters.name: currency_code
parameters.description: Currency to price seat upgrades in (USD or PTS for Rapid Rewards points)

parameters.name: flow_type
parameters.description: Seat-selection flow context. STANDALONE = post-booking upgrade flow.
